== Introduction ==
A one day tournament run by [[Ake Vader]] to encourage activity and bring some great games to the spectators.

* Running date: 1st of June [[2014]]

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[ztndm3]], [[aerowalk]]
* Allowed clients: [[ezQuake]] (>= 2.1) -ruleset smackdown, [[FodQuake]] (>= 0.2) -ruleset eql, [[FTEQW]] (>= 1.00) -ruleset nqr
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* No fairpacks
* Discharges enabled
* KTX2 spawns. (unless both players agree on a different mode)
* Maxfps 77.
* No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes.
* Fallbunny on.
